decision.observation: Actually reviewed all240 whole-scene thumbnails of raw, rejected v1 and selected v2. For selected v2, reviewed all240 frames separately for plush face, plush body and badge face/outline (45 detail pages), every186 detector box on12 pages, native whole-scene frames0,86,89,90,91,92,96,144,147,148,149,150,154,239, original M04/M05 RGBA masters, actual768p input first frame and first-frame template scope/native trials. Raw and v1 incomplete detail/candidate viewing remains separately limited in their rejection receipts. The lake, rocks, grass and black bag continue the original retreat without an observed whole-scene reset. No real person, head, face or extra limb was observed; both character depictions are existing female merchandise. The original open star-pattern irises, fine round gold glasses and fixed mouths are preserved; no blink or invented acting. The complete native first-frame inert-prop templates stabilize plush pendant, bodice, skirt, feet, hat and ribbons, and the complete circular badge through90to91 and148to149. No obvious detached contour, doubled prop or feather seam was observed in the reviewed contexts. The template includes original body texture, complete outline and a small feathered surrounding area, not only eyes; whole-frame CRF16 encoding is lossy. Natural shrinking/translation and background motion remain. Source remains10s/240native frames, all used; no interpolation, retiming or changed other shot durations. Assistant image-sequence review, not human continuous playback, listening, every4Kpixel certification or full-film approval.

rawRejection.observation: Actually viewed all 240 raw whole-scene frames and native whole frames 0/239; native join checkpoints 86/89/90/91/92/96/144/147/148/149/150/154; M04 and M05 original RGBA masters and actual input frame 0. Printed detail review so far covers frames 0-15 and 80-95 for EACH prop, and candidate crop pages 1-4 (64 boxes); other exported detail/candidate pages are not claimed viewed. Whole landscape, retreating camera, rocks and bag remain continuous; no observed real human head/face, added person or human limb. Both original masters have OPEN eyes. M05 has coarse gray/dark irises and distorted glasses/face contours. At the expected native window joins 90->91 and 148->149, printed or embroidered face/eye/fringe/mouth details change on the physically inert props. M04 also has changes in pendant/bodice detail. This is not an original closed-to-open eye change. Reject raw reference appearance and local prop-texture continuity; no restoration has been accepted. The complete 10-second duration, original camera motion and all other timings remain unchanged.

rejectedV1.observation: All240 corrected whole-scene frames were actually viewed. Face detail page06 for each prop shows stable restored open irises and glasses but still a distinct change at90->91 in the M04 pendant/bodice and M05 surrounding hat/rim/body print. Eye-only repair does not fix the complete inert merchandise texture. No claim of viewing other corrected print pages or any corrected candidate crops. Reject local prop continuity and merchandise behavior; preserve v1 and all evidence. No source selection or final-film approval.

selection.reason: Actual all240 whole-scene frames, all240 frames of each of three prop details, all186 candidate boxes and native whole-scene window-boundary contexts reviewed. Original M04/M05 faces and complete inert first-frame props retained; v1 body/outline discontinuity rejected.

regions.templateScope: Full original native frame-zero inert prop, outline and nearby background feather; reference-restored face; independently tracked from the unchanged raw video. No person removal or new artwork.

actualCorrectionReceipt.method: Independent unmodified-prop tracking. Original RGBA details are projected directly, or first combined with the same fully visible native frame-zero inert prop and then tracked as a complete template. One CRF16 encode from the unchanged raw source.
actualCorrectionReceipt.scope: Explicit per-region masks may include the full inert prop, outline and nearby background feather when an inertSourcePolygon is provided. Otherwise masks may include fringe, cheeks, nose, mouth or chin. Whole-frame lossy re-encoding. No person covered or removed.
